mapper.insert: insert into user_action( user_id, item_id, action_type, extra_data ) values( #{userId}, #{itemId}, #{actionType}, #{extraData} )
mapper.select: select id, user_id as userId, item_id as itemId, action_type as actionType, extra_data as extraData, create_time as createTime from user_action order by id desc
select id, user_id as userId, item_id as itemId, action_type as actionType, extra_data as extraData, create_time as createTime from user_action where id = #{id}
SELECT id, user_id as userId, item_id as itemId, action_type as actionType FROM user_action WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND item_id = #{itemId}

select id, user_id as userId, item_id as itemId, action_type as actionType, extra_data as extraData, create_time as createTime from user_action where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc limit #{limit}
